threads.body: [Config] The stable flat replacement is only read through `ExtendedOpenTelemetry`'s config provider. For supported standalone/library usage with a plain `OpenTelemetry` instance (for example `OpenTelemetry.noop()`), setting `otel.instrumentation.common.span-suppression-strategy` leaves `result` null, while the deprecated flat property still works through the direct `SystemProperty` fallback below. Users who migrate to the advertised replacement therefore silently revert to `semconv`. Read the stable system property as a fallback before checking either deprecated name.
